title: Sustainable Rice Farming Practices Explained
reason: Provides detailed instructions for sustainable rice farming.

tasks.task: Attend a Kana meeting with extension officers to select rice varieties and create a crop calendar.

subtasks.text: Attend a Kana meeting with extension officers in your area to select the best rice variety and create a crop calendar for the season.
Request instructions on how to use water more efficiently and appoint a water controller.

tasks.task: Implement water management techniques to maximize efficiency.

subtasks.text: Learn how to use seeds of the most adapted rice varieties for the area and season.
Follow the recommendations of the Rice Research and Development Institute for the MAHA season.
Form buns and plaster to hold water for every season.
Place a field water tube to monitor the water level.

tasks.task: Optimize planting methods to reduce seed requirements and increase yield.

subtasks.text: Plant based on the second week of October instead of the fourth week to save water.
Use improved rice planting methods compared to broadcasting.
Transplant rice instead of broadcasting for higher yields and savings.
Establish a nursery using parachute method or transplanting machines.
Utilize motorized transplanting services if you have a plot of at least 0.2 hectares.

tasks.task: Manage weeds effectively during the first 30 days.

subtasks.text: Weed management practices for motorized transplanter rice.
Use a manual cono weeder for rice seeded with a drum seeder.

tasks.task: Manage water levels efficiently for optimal crop health.

subtasks.text: Irrigate the field to five centimeters above the surface level and allow draining until 15 centimeters below surface level.
Irrigate based on weeds observed while keeping water 15 centimeters below the surface level.
Maintain water level 0 to 5 centimeters above the surface level two weeks after flowering.

tasks.task: Prepare for harvesting and post-harvest care.

subtasks.text: Prepare a 3.5 month variety with the right moisture level (22-25%) for harvest at week 12.
Use moisture measurement services at One Stop Super to reduce grain damages.

tasks.task: Ensure field management and storage practices.

subtasks.text: Keep straw on the field post-harvest.
Dry paddy efficiently and economically using mobile paddy drying.
